title: Restaurant Front Office Executive
description:
Job description:

* Welcome and greet guests warmly upon arrival
* Manage table reservations and walk\-in guests
* Coordinate with the floor staff and managers for smooth seating arrangements
* Answer phone calls and handle customer inquiries professionally
* Maintain waiting lists during peak hours
* Assist guests with feedback and basic complaints politely
* Ensure reception and entrance area is clean and presentable
* Inform guests about ongoing offers, events, or special menus
* Maintain reservation records and guest database
* Support restaurant operations whenever required
* Requirements
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Pleasant personality and professional appearance
* Basic computer knowledge and reservation handling
* Ability to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays
* Minimum qualification: Higher Secondary / Graduate preferred
* Experience in restaurant or hospitality industry preferred
* Skills Required
* Customer service
* Communication skills
* Team coordination
* Problem\-solving ability
* Time management
* Positive attitude under pressure
* Salary \& Benefits
* Competitive salary
* Incentives based on performance
* Staff meals
* Weekly off
* Growth opportunities within the organization

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹16,000\.00 per month
